Done. All four owned files curated and verified (`cargo check -p sniff-css-check --all-targets` clean; 220 lib tests + 3 integration tests pass).

Files changed:
- `crates/sniff-css-check/src/modern/responsive.rs`: `breakpoint-jump` now only pairs same-emulation/different-viewport states, skips nodes outside either viewport, suppresses proportional reflow (width/height scaling with viewport width plus bounded positional residual), emits one worst-residual line per paired node, and caps at 12 lines with a single `__check_summary` note. Added tests for off-screen footer, proportional logo, emulation changes, dedup, and cap/aggregate.
- `crates/sniff-css-check/src/modern/forms.rs`: `persistent-bar-budget` measures clamped viewport intersection (≤1.0), requires pinned (fixed/sticky/overlay) semantics, skips flow content and empty intersections, and avoids double-reporting pinned nodes via bar-height plus coverage. Added tests for >100% raw-area flow content, giant fixed rect, small sticky notice, and off-screen content.
- `crates/sniff-css-check/src/rules.rs`: `occluded` now requires the coverer to actually paint above (z-index/stacking context, positioned overlay, overlay role, or translucent scrim) in addition to the stacking heuristic; pure in-flow rect overlap no longer fails. Added negative (logo vs. sibling nav) and positive (absolute overlay) tests; adjusted the DOM-order fixture to carry positioned semantics.
- `crates/sniff-css-check/tests/check_integration.rs`: restored all pre-existing imports and added a v2 matrix integration test for curated `breakpoint-jump`.

Note for Main: I temporarily added the missing `#[error]` on `DiffError::MixedLayout` in `crates/sniff-css-diff/src/error.rs` only to unblock compilation while that peer edit was in flight, then restored my backup — that file remains modified by ValidationFix (summary-digest work); please confirm its final state. The new responsive cap note uses check id `breakpoint-jump` with selector `__check_summary` (no new check id), available for docs reconciliation.
